devnet_status.highlight: Teku batching gossip objects into single RPC exceeds Lodestar's 4MB incoming limit; PR open to raise limit to 10MB
FOCIL devnet-0 minimum bar is 2 EL + 2 CL clients; 3 EL clients ready, waiting on Teku+Lodestar interop fix to launch

focil_frames_interaction.highlight: EIP-8369 (VOPS Profiles for FOCIL Eligibility) defines two profiles: Profile 1 = FOCIL with regular txs, Profile 2 = FOCIL + frame txs
VOPS state boundary is key trade-off: larger VOPS = more txs benefit from FOCIL guarantees but higher node storage requirements
Builder index (witness for frame tx omission) mechanism unresolved: unclear if separate object or embedded in existing payload envelope
Nethermind and ethrex both have untested FOCIL+frames implementations; ethrex spec PR expected within 1–2 weeks

action_items.action: ethrex to open spec PR for FOCIL+frames interaction; target: before next breakout
Marc and Iván to share FOCIL+frames implementation links in Discord for cross-team review

decisions.decision: FOCIL devnet-0 will launch once Teku+Lodestar interop issue is resolved; no need to wait for all clients
Two-track approach adopted: continue FOCIL devnet-0 work in parallel with FOCIL+frames spec and interaction design
